description: Reviews VTTForge CLI commands that write a project: the scaffold, lint fixes, and the v14 migration written in place. The audit, the lint report and the migration preview stay unreviewed.
name: VTTForge command protection
saferAlternatives: Run the preview forms first: `vttforge migrate` and `vttforge lint` without --write or --fix.
Run the writing forms on a clean git tree and review the diff.
